budget.cost_scope: All preparation, calibration, research calls, failures, training, controls and scoring after the recorded start count toward this research wall clock. Cached-data reruns use their explicitly requested new campaign start; original dataset verification timestamps are preserved.

pre_budget.scope: Dataset acquisition, environment setup and checks before recorded dataset verification; excluded from research clock, retained as preparation cost.

budget.assessment: validation during research; held-out closed until a frozen final suite

selection_policy.missing_task: invalid; never average only the available tasks
selection_policy.regression_policy: Report each task's AUC and Logloss change against the reference and entry model; explain trade-offs in topic decisions. No undeclared per-task veto threshold.
selection_policy.test_policy: Selection uses validation only; freeze before a single held-out assessment. Historical completed test suites remain unchanged.
